notablePrerequisites: Strangleroot Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist undying trigger, returning Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing a player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Strangleroot Geist, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
